title: Tiny, cute train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rails -->
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>
  <rect x='8' y='88' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#A0896A'/>
  <!-- Rail ties -->
  <rect x='16' y='82' width='3' height='10' fill='#6B5B4A'/>
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='3' height='10' fill='#6B5B4A'/>
  <rect x='48' y='82' width='3' height='10' fill='#6B5B4A'/>
  <rect x='64' y='82' width='3' height='10' fill='#6B5B4A'/>
  <rect x='80' y='82' width='3' height='10' fill='#6B5B4A'/>
  <!-- Train body main -->
  <rect x='28' y='40' width='44' height='34' rx='6' fill='#E84040'/>
  <!-- Body lighter bottom stripe -->
  <rect x='28' y='62' width='44' height='12' rx='6' fill='#F07070'/>
  <!-- Cabin roof -->
  <rect x='20' y='32' width='28' height='12' rx='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Cabin roof shine -->
  <rect x='22' y='34' width='24' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFEB80'/>
  <!-- Cabin window -->
  <rect x='24' y='42' width='20' height='14' rx='3' fill='#A8D8F0'/>
  <!-- Window shine -->
  <rect x='27' y='45' width='7' height='5' rx='1' fill='#D8F0FF'/>
  <!-- Boiler front -->
  <rect x='28' y='40' width='14' height='34' rx='6' fill='#E84040'/>
  <!-- Chimney -->
  <rect x='30' y='24' width='10' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5A5A6A'/>
  <rect x='27' y='22' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7A7A8A'/>
  <!-- Smoke -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='16' r='5' fill='#C8C8D8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='10' r='6' fill='#D8D8E8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4.5' fill='#C8C8D8'/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='48' r='4' fill='#FFE040'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='48' r='2' fill='#FFFFC0'/>
  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x='26' y='70' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='76' r='7' fill='#5A5A6A'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#9A9AAA'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='76' r='7' fill='#5A5A6A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#9A9AAA'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='7' fill='#5A5A6A'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='#9A9AAA'/>
  <!-- Wheel spokes -->
  <line x1='36' y1='70' x2='36' y2='82' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='76' x2='42' y2='76' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='70' x2='56' y2='82' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='76' x2='62' y2='76' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='70' x2='70' y2='82' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='76' x2='76' y2='76' stroke='#B0B0C0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Coupling -->
  <rect x='72' y='58' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Cute face on the boiler -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='52' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M38 58 Q43 63 48 58' stroke='#2A2A4A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheek blushes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='57' r='3' fill='#FF80A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='57' r='3' fill='#FF80A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Roof detail line -->
  <line x1='24' y1='38' x2='44' y2='38' stroke='#E8C000' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
